bounded_task: Full sharp centered Gaussian-gradient exponential inequality (4.3) only; source-only preparation before proposed exact signature, SourceProofGraph review or implementation. No next SAU claimed.
primary_read_scope: Whole §4.1 with original complete balanced spans
S1 initial C² and curvature standing assumptions
S2 normalization, prox definition, numerical-query cap
S3.1 smoothing, true smoothed score and actual Gaussian gradient estimator

objects.domain: finite-dimensional Euclidean R^d with ordinary real inner product and norm
objects.literal_prox: p_η(y)=unique global argmin_x {V(x)+‖x−y‖²/(2η)}; original definition S2.E1, reused S4.Ex3
objects.law: G∼γ_d=N(0,I_d), actual output law pushforward H_y#γ_d; neither R_{η,y} nor affine standardized posterior r_y
objects.mean: m_η(y)=∫H_y(z)dγ_d(z) is the actual first Bochner expectation; construct actual integrability before using it
objects.center: ξ_η(y;z)=H_y(z)−m_η(y). Deterministic b_η(y)=m_η(y)−g_η(y). Source zero-mean decomposition forces this centering once L1 exists.
objects.smoothed_score: g_η=∇V_η, exp(−V_η)=exp(−V)*N(0,ηI). It is an RGO/conditional expectation and generally differs from m_η by bias.

domains.smoothing: η>0 inherited S3.SS1.p1.1; no analytic upper eta cap stated on Lemma4.2 sharp Gaussian-noise clause
domains.directions: all u∈R^d; no unit-norm, bounded, positive or nonzero restriction
domains.scalar: source printed formula has no separate scalar. Signed parametrization t∈R via u=t a, with arbitrary a∈R^d, is equivalent.
domains.endpoints: u=0, t=0 and a=0 included. Source does not explicitly impose positive dimension in these source anchors; zero-dimensional Euclidean extension gives identity1≤1.

seven_source_slots.quantifiers: For every allowed V satisfying the global standing normalized assumptions, every η>0, every y∈R^d and every u∈R^d, one actual m_η(y) is fixed before varying u, and E_γ exp(⟨u,H_y−m_η(y)⟩)≤exp(η‖u‖²/2). Equivalent signed version: ∀a ∀t∈R, E_γ exp(t⟨a,H_y−m_η(y)⟩)≤exp(η t²‖a‖²/2).

assumptions.standing: V genuinely globally C²; original 0<α≤β, αI≼D²V(x)≼βI pointwise; normalized β=1 and α=κ⁻¹ with κ≥1. Original source S1.p1.1/S1.E1/S2.p1.1.
assumptions.local: η>0; y,u arbitrary deterministic Euclidean vectors; integration against actual canonical standard Gaussian.
ingredients_not_public_premises: gradient1-Lipschitz derived from C² and normalized Hessian
actual Gaussian probability, vector/scalar firstL1 and integrable signed exponentials
actual Bochner/scalar mean and projection/integral commutation
genuine standard Gaussian concentration with exact1/2 coefficient
assumptions.reference_point: S2 assumes admissible x_ref for sampling algorithm; no x_ref occurs in Lemma4.2 estimator/concentration clause, so it is irrelevant to this local observable result.

seven_source_slots.conclusion: Exact finite numerical exponential expectation inequality with sharp dimensionfree variance proxyη‖u‖² and coefficient1/2. Finite/domain-only expectations do not establish it. No totalized integral alone substitutes for genuine domain proof.
seven_source_slots.scopes_senses: Fixed y unconditional expectation only over the Gaussian noise in the actual gradient estimator. Source is not conditional concentration in y, posterior law concentration, invariant distribution convergence, W2/T2, bias, numerical query/cost, full Lemma4.2 or main sampler theorem.

constant_dependencies.dimension: No d in numerical sharp coefficient. Radial norm envelopes may certify finiteness but cannot supply sharp dimensionfree1/2.
constant_dependencies.normalized_beta: Exact source formula uses β=1. An unnormalized bound would require independently tracked β², not silently copied source coefficient.
constant_dependencies.kappa: Retained source curvature lower bound enables actual prox; sharp numerical concentration coefficient does not depend onκ.

neighbor_scope_audit.scope: neighbor Lemma4.1 smoothed-Hessian bound; not a binder of sharp4.3 local Gaussian gradient clause

neighbor_scope_audit.printed: Actual numerical proximal queries use step at most1/(2β)
neighbor_scope_audit.scope: source algorithm numerical-query implementation/work regime; not an analytic concentration restriction. Keep visible and separate, no unlimited-query permission.

actual_definition_semantics.prox_definition_kind: characterized unique minimizer, not arbitrary measurable supplied selector or fallbackzero
actual_definition_semantics.oracle_definition_kind: literal gradient/prox/√η Gaussian-noise composition on every source allowed input
actual_definition_semantics.xi_definition_kind: literal actual oracle minus actual Bochner mean, consistent with deterministic bias+zero-mean source decomposition
actual_definition_semantics.smoothed_gradient_centering: Rejected: H_y−g_η(y) is generally biased and cannot be substituted for ξ_η.

background_source_invocation.printed_route: Actual oracle is√η-Lipschitz in Gaussian input → standard Gaussian concentration → full sharp4.3; the same Lipschitz observation gives4.5.
background_source_invocation.background: Source names standard Gaussian concentration without theorem number or proof in this paragraph. Do not invent bibliographic theorem numbering or claim compiled certificate.
background_source_invocation.reconstruction_boundary: This is a source invocation description only. No independent SourceProofGraph was authored or accepted in this preread.

source_implicit_obligations: Actual proximal definition must be well-defined from source curvature andη>0.
Genuine vector/scalar L1 and signed exponential domains justify the expectation and centering expression.
A sharp Gaussian Lipschitz concentration background is required; mere Fernique/radial finiteness is insufficient.
Source C²/Hessian upper assumption supplies actual gradient and noise Lipschitzness internally, never as extra source binders.

edge_cases.dimension_zero: R^0 has unique zero vector; oracle and mean zero; exponentzero and both sides1. Explicit finite-dimensional representation may include this harmless endpoint.
edge_cases.direction_zero: At u=0 or a=0 both sides1 for every signed realt.
edge_cases.signed_t: Every positive, zero and negative realt is included through arbitrary u=t a.
edge_cases.unbounded_positive_eta: The sharp concentration clause is mathematically valid for every finiteη>0 from actual√η-Lipschitz oracle. Numerical proximal-query cap and neighbor4.1 remain separately scoped.
edge_cases.eta_zero: Outside source smoothing/prox definition domain; no off-sourceη=0 fallback included.
